structuredRun.description: Runs the agent once, non-interactively, with the prompt on stdin and a JSON Schema the answer must follow. Placeholders must be whole arguments: {schema} is the schema as JSON, {schemaPath} a file containing it, {outputPath} a file the agent writes its answer to, and {settings} the arguments chosen by settingArgs.

settingArgs.description: Arguments that follow the plugin's settings, inserted in order at the {settings} placeholder. Boolean settings use args when true and otherwise when false. Other settings use args when they have a value, replacing {value} inside each argument with it; string values must come from the setting's choices. Schema 14: an entry with when applies only while that boolean setting is on, and one with unless only while it is off, so two settings can share an argument such as a tool list.

when.description: Schema 14. A boolean setting that must be on for this entry to apply.

unless.description: Schema 14. A boolean setting that must be off for this entry to apply.

imageArgs.description: Arguments that attach one image the agent can look at, repeated for each image at the {images} placeholder; {imagePath} is replaced with the image's file. Omit when the agent cannot take images.

imageInput.description: Schema 13. How to show images to an agent that reads a structured message on stdin instead of taking image arguments. When images are attached, args are added to the run and stdin becomes one JSON line built from the stdin template: the string "{prompt}" becomes the prompt and an array element "{images}" expands to one copy of the image template per image, with "{data}" replaced by the image's base64 bytes and "{mediaType}" by its type (image/png, image/jpeg, image/gif or image/webp; other images and ones over 5 MB are left out). Runs without images send the plain prompt.

progress.description: Patterns that turn lines the agent prints while it works into steps the host can show: what it is thinking about, what it searches for, or other steps. A pattern's first capture group is the step's text; without one, label is used.

pointer.description: For agents that print one JSON event per line: the JSON Pointer to the text to match, such as a search query or a thinking summary. Lines without a string there are skipped; only the text's first line is matched.
JSON Pointer to the answer inside the document. Omit when the document is the answer.

errorPointer.description: JSON Pointer to a boolean that is true when the agent reports failure.

ephemeralArgs.description: Arguments inserted at {ephemeral} when no follow-up is expected, so the agent keeps no session.

resume.description: How to send a follow-up message to the session of an earlier run.

args.description: Arguments for the follow-up run; must contain {session} and {schema} or {schemaPath} (and {outputPath} for outputFile results).

session.description: Where the agent prints its session ID: a pattern whose first group is the ID, or a JSON Pointer into one-event-per-line output.

cleanup.description: Where the agent keeps session files, so Arrumo can delete the sessions it kept once their video is done (or right after a request without a video). Files under directory, in the folder homeEnv names (absolute paths only) or else home inside the user's home folder, whose names end with fileSuffix; links are not followed.

workFolderSetting.description: Schema 14. A boolean setting that, while on, means the agent may write files and run commands. The editor then runs every stage of a video in one work folder kept for that video's run, tells the agent so, and removes the folder after the run ends. Declare the matching arguments in settingArgs.

imageRun.description: Makes one image with the agent's own image tool, for agents that declare the image-generation capability. The prompt goes to stdin and the agent stays read-only: it prints one JSON event per line, one of which names its session, and leaves the image in a folder named after that session. Arrumo collects the newest PNG, JPEG or WebP file there, verifies it and removes what the run left. {images} attaches style references with structuredRun.imageArgs.

sessionPointer.description: JSON Pointer to the session ID in one of the printed events, such as /thread_id.

outputDirectory.description: Where the agent leaves images: path under the directory named by the environment variable env, or under fallback inside the home directory when env is unset.

usageRun.description: Schema 11. Reads the agent's remaining allowance without using it: the CLI starts with args, each input value is written to stdin as one JSON line, and the first printed JSON line whose id equals responseId is read. Arrumo shows the most used window.

usedPercent.description: Share of the window used, 0 to 100.

usageEvent.description: Schema 12. Reads the agent's remaining allowance from an event it prints during ordinary runs, so no extra request is made. Arrumo keeps the latest reading and shows the most used window until it resets.

typePointer.description: JSON Pointer to the event's type in each printed JSON line.

scale.description: Whether used runs 0 to 1 or 0 to 100.

usageText.description: Schema 16. Reads the agent's remaining allowance from text a command of its own prints without using any of it, such as a usage report. The CLI starts with args and nothing on stdin; each window's pattern (a Rust regex) captures used, the share used in percent, and may capture resets, the local reset time written like `Dec 3, 2:59am` or `2:59pm`. Arrumo shows the most used window.

pattern.description: Rust regex with a named group used and optionally resets.

introduction.description: Schema 8: shown once in the plugin tour after the plugin arrives. English is required; Spanish and Portuguese are used when the app is in those languages.

translations.description: Schema 8: the plugin's own text in other languages. English stays in the manifest's fields; an en entry may only add labels such as setting choices. Every key must name something the manifest declares.

icon.description: Schema 8: path inside the package to a self-contained SVG icon of at most 8 KiB (no script, event handlers, external or embedded references). The packager adds it to the ZIP. Draw it as a full square tile with its own background colour, without rounded corners or a border: Arrumo rounds it. Plugins without one get a default icon.

iconNotice.description: Schema 8: required when the icon is a brand mark: who owns it, such as "ElevenLabs and its logo are trademarks of ElevenLabs." Shown beside the icon. Use a mark only when the owner's published brand guidelines allow it in another app; see the README section on brand marks.

choices.description: For string settings: the only values allowed, shown as a choice list.

default.description: The value used when neither the app nor the workspace sets one. Not allowed for secrets.

helpUrl.description: Schema 10: an https page explaining where to get the value, such as the provider's API key page. Arrumo opens it from the installed manifest only.

warning.description: Schema 14. A short caution shown while a boolean setting is on, such as what it lets the plugin do on the creator's computer.

hiddenWhen.description: Schema 14. Another boolean setting of this plugin that, while on, makes this one irrelevant, so the editor hides it.

suggestions.description: Schema 15. For string settings without choices: values the editor offers as presets, such as model names. Any other value is still allowed. Label them in translations under choices.

inputs.description: Schema 9: the form Arrumo shows for the action. The host sends an object keyed by input ID. Without inputs the action takes a JSON object typed by hand.

placements.description: Schema 9: where Arrumo offers the action besides Settings: beside a draft, on a video's generation page, or on a finished video.

hooks.description: Schema 9: events that run a workspace action on its own, at most one hook per event. Each hook runs only while the boolean setting named by enabledBy is on for the workspace. The action receives the event instead of form inputs: video-completed runs once per finished video, generation-failed once per failed attempt, publish-date-reached once per finished output on its planned date.

enabledBy.description: The id of a boolean setting declared by this plugin.

kind.description: text and longText send a string; number a number; boolean true or false; choice one of choices; language a language tag; subtitles the text of an SRT track, picked from the video in view, opened from a file or pasted; json any JSON value typed by hand.

canvasRenderer.description: Schema 17. Lets agents draw animation layers as small web pages (WebGL, canvas, SVG, CSS and the libraries listed here). Arrumo downloads the headless browser for the creator's platform when they ask, checks its SHA-256, and renders each page frame by frame without network or file access.

guide.description: Package path of Markdown the agent reads before writing a canvas layer.

executable.description: Path of the headless browser inside the archive.

module.description: Loaded as an ES module named by id in the page's import map; otherwise as a classic script.
